name: cmdb_global_attr
label: Configuration Management -- global_attr Table
description: Configure the global_attr table, which belongs to the configuration management module. This table is used for reporting scenarios related to enabling state filtering in configuration management.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique identifier. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: is_private
fields.description: Private attributes cannot be edited or deleted.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
